title: GraphQL: Query Your Content With One Request | Orchard Core
description:
A page, an app or a static site often needs several requests to collect content, and each response carries fields the client never uses.

The GraphQL module of Orchard Core builds a schema from your content types and serves it at one endpoint. A client asks for exactly the fields it needs, related content items included, in a single request, and every request is checked against permissions.

In this video:
• Why GraphQL, and what the module builds from your content types
• Enabling the module and finding GraphiQL in the admin
• Running a first query, including a blog with its posts
• What the schema contains, and the arguments of a content type query
• Calling the endpoint with GET and POST, the response, and who can run queries
• The configuration options that limit queries and results
• Extending the schema with your own parts and queries
